name: family-and-community-building
description: Family and Community Building: how to read claims in this field, attachment, what predicts couple stability, conflict and repair, transitions and dissolution, family systems, family roles and life stages, child development, parenting, behaviour genetics, discipline, siblings and birth order, family structure as contested territory, adversity and resilience, caregiving and aging, social capital, networks and belonging, loneliness and social isolation, third places, congregations and voluntary associations, community organizing, collective efficacy, and how to tell whether a program actually works.
